_about: The same schematic's plan view (TOP): layers.py --mode image --threshold 170 at scale 4, clip 15,240,710,815, --xscale 0.9148 (as the side). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's left side; mirrored, the same). The fuselage's side is hidden under the wing (bridged) and aft under the tailplane: its end at the tail cone is placed by its line carried on (free). The tailplane's root is at the fin's side (a T-tail).
